title: Workforce
subtitle: Develop people, conversations, and talent from one clear workspace.
employeeSubtitle: View and use only the parts available for your own development.
gridNineDescription: Bring performance and potential together in a clear 9-grid overview.

mcp.instructions: LiquidHR Workforce provides read-only information about your own data as an employee or your own direct team as a direct manager. The server determines your current role and team context and rejects attempts to choose an employee, team, tenant, HR group, administration, or role context. Manager results contain only permitted team data. This MCP has no write actions.
mcp.employeeScopeDisclosure: The server determines the current employee context; do not send an employee, team, tenant, administration, or role selector.
mcp.managerScopeDisclosure: The server determines the current manager and direct-team scope; do not send an employee, team, tenant, administration, or role selector.

employee.talent.development-plans.read.title: Read your development plans
employee.talent.development-plans.read.description: Read the status and progress of your own development plans.

employee.talent.development-gaps.read.title: Read your development gaps
employee.talent.development-gaps.read.description: Read your own development points from the current job profile.

employee.leave.balance.read.title: Read your leave balance
employee.leave.balance.read.description: Read your own balance by leave type, as of date, and relevant expiry details. If you have multiple active employments, choose only from the returned options for your own employments.

employee.leave.next.read.title: Read your next approved leave
employee.leave.next.read.description: Read your next future leave request with APPROVED status.

employee.leave.requests.read.title: Read your leave requests
employee.leave.requests.read.description: Read your own pending and approved leave requests, with dates, hours, and status.

employee.reminders.read.title: Read your personal reminders
employee.reminders.read.description: Read only your own personal reminders, due dates, and status.

manager.team.overview.read.title: Read your direct-team overview
manager.team.overview.read.description: Read the names of active employees in your own direct team.

manager.work.pending.read.title: Read pending team work
manager.work.pending.read.description: Read outstanding actionable tasks and leave requests for your own direct team.

manager.leave.calendar.read.title: Read approved team leave
manager.leave.calendar.read.description: Read approved leave for your own direct team over the next 90 days.

manager.talent.development-plans.read.title: Read team development plans

manager.talent.follow-ups.read.title: Read team follow-ups

manager.talent.team-capability-matrix.re.title: Read team capabilities
manager.talent.team-capability-matrix.re.description: Read the permitted capability data for your direct team.
